explanation.title: Why field-aware and item-contextual?
explanation.body: A changed description does not spend tokens retranslating an unchanged title. The AI still receives the complete item and translates every stale field in one request, so terminology stays coherent across the record.

overview.title: Access control
overview.description: Roles provide workspace-wide permissions. Inventory rules add narrowly scoped actions when an item matches every condition.

roles.title: Workspace roles
roles.description: Combine individual permissions into reusable roles that can be assigned to workspace members.

roles.emptyDescription: Create a role to give workspace members a precise set of permissions.

rules.title: Conditional inventory rules
rules.description: Grant a role extra actions for inventory items that match every condition in a rule.
rules.editorDescription: Rules only grant additional access. They never remove permissions already provided by the role.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.actionsDescription: These actions become available only for inventory items that match all conditions below.
rules.conditionsDescription: All conditions are combined with AND. Use a stable item ID for one specific item, or fields such as tags, categories, type, and custom fields for a group.
rules.customFieldHint: For a custom field, enter customFields. followed by its stable key, for example customFields.department.
rules.emptyDescription: Add a rule when a role should receive extra actions only for a specific item or matching group.
